en.summary: The commit fixes a cache-response deadlock by making the selector hold one response group until that group actually handshakes, instead of recomputing a new group from whichever request happens to appear first each cycle.
why_it_counts: The patch changes central DUT arbitration used by multiple cache response consumers
The fix introduces locked arbitration tied to rsp_fire, which is a direct forward-progress repair
The companion VX_fair_arbiter change corrects how buffered requests stay eligible while a lock is held
evidence: VX_cache_rsp_sel replaces VX_find_first with a VX_rr_arbiter that has LOCK_ENABLE=1 and unlock=rsp_fire
Selection now uses grant_index and grant_valid, and ready is returned only to the locked response group
VX_fair_arbiter changes from use_buffer bookkeeping to buffer_qual = buffer & requests and forces grant_valid from any active request, avoiding stale buffered grants

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: When multiple cache response lanes carry fragments that belong to the same logical response group, the response selector must keep that group selected until the group actually transfers. If the selector instead recomputes its choice combinationally every cycle from the currently visible requests, backpressure can make the chosen group change underneath the handshake. That can strand partially selected responses, misdirect ready signals, and deadlock the response network.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Multiple response groups are simultaneously valid and downstream backpressure prevents immediate transfer
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Remove the lock that keeps one response group selected until handshake completion, or revert to a combinational first-hit group choice each cycle
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: replace locked arbitration with unstable first-match selection
portability_notes: Use this on any response selector that groups lanes or banks by a shared tag subset or transaction identity
The important property is stable grant ownership across stalls, not specifically round-robin fairness
If the DUT already has a locking arbiter, disabling unlock-tied hold behavior is the closest mutation
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the logic that merges or selects among multiple cache response sources belonging to logical response groups
Identify the state or arbiter lock that preserves the selected group while downstream ready is low
Remove that hold behavior so the selected group is recomputed from current requests every cycle
Ensure ready is again driven from that unstable selection so the injected bug affects both selection and backpressure routing

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: cache response group selection and fair-arbiter buffering
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix replaces find-first selection with a locked round-robin grant that is released on rsp_fire, and updates VX_fair_arbiter so buffered requests remain consistent with currently active requests.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_cache_rsp_sel, revert to a combinational first-hit tag selection or disable the rr-arbiter lock; in VX_fair_arbiter, restore the older use_buffer behavior if needed to recreate stale or unstable grants.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Under contention and backpressure, response groups can lose stable ownership of the output path, causing ready/valid progress to stop and the cache response network to deadlock.
evidence_for_injection: rsp_fire is explicitly defined as grant_valid && rsp_ready_unqual and used as the arbiter unlock condition
The old design chose a tag through VX_find_first each cycle, which offered no persistent ownership across stalls
The arbiter helper fix shows stale buffered requests were part of the same forward-progress problem
notes: The portable bug is unstable response-group ownership under backpressure
If a smaller mutation is preferred, removing lock retention in the selector is usually sufficient without fully reverting the helper arbiter

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 cache response 选择器死锁：选择器现在会持续锁定同一个响应组直到真正完成握手，而不是每个周期都根据当前“第一个出现”的请求重新组合选择目标。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改了多个 cache 响应消费者共用的核心 DUT 仲裁逻辑
修复通过把锁定释放条件绑定到 rsp_fire，直接解决了前向进展问题
配套的 VX_fair_arbiter 修改修正了锁保持期间缓冲请求的资格计算方式
evidence: VX_cache_rsp_sel 用带 LOCK_ENABLE=1 且 unlock=rsp_fire 的 VX_rr_arbiter 替换了 VX_find_first
选择逻辑现在使用 grant_index 和 grant_valid，并且 ready 只返回给当前锁定的响应组
VX_fair_arbiter 从 use_buffer 逻辑改成了 buffer_qual = buffer & requests，并且 grant_valid 改为由任一活跃请求驱动，以避免陈旧缓冲 grant

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当多个 cache response lane 携带属于同一逻辑响应组的片段时，响应选择器必须持续锁定该响应组，直到该组真正完成传输。如果选择器每个周期都只根据当前可见请求做组合式重新选择，那么在背压存在时，已选中的响应组会在握手过程中被换掉，导致部分已选响应被悬空、ready 被送错方向，最终卡死响应网络。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 多个响应组同时有效，并且下游背压使其无法立刻完成传输
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 移除“一个响应组在握手完成前持续被选中”的锁保持机制，或恢复为每周期重新组合选择 first-hit 响应组
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 用不稳定的 first-match 选择替代锁定式仲裁
portability_notes: 适用于任何按 tag 子集或事务身份对多个 lane 或 bank 响应做分组选择的模块
关键属性是 stall 期间 grant 归属必须稳定，而不只是 round-robin 的公平性
如果 DUT 已有 locking arbiter，最接近的变异就是关闭与 unlock 绑定的保持行为
concrete_injection_steps: 找到负责在多个 cache response 源之间按逻辑响应组进行合并或选择的逻辑
识别在下游 ready 为低时用于保持当前选中组的状态或仲裁器锁
移除这类保持机制，使被选中的响应组每个周期都从当前请求重新计算
让 ready 重新由这种不稳定选择结果驱动，以便同时破坏选择与反压回传

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: cache 响应组选择逻辑以及 fair-arbiter 的缓冲资格控制
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把基于 find-first 的选择改成了在 rsp_fire 时解锁的轮询锁定 grant，同时更新 VX_fair_arbiter 以保证缓冲请求只在当前仍活跃时继续参与仲裁。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_cache_rsp_sel 中恢复为组合式 first-hit tag 选择，或关闭 rr-arbiter 锁；如需完全复现旧行为，可在 VX_fair_arbiter 中恢复旧的 use_buffer 逻辑。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在竞争和背压同时存在时，响应组会失去对输出路径的稳定归属，导致 ready/valid 无法继续前进，最终卡死整个 cache response 网络。
evidence_for_injection: rsp_fire 被明确定义为 grant_valid && rsp_ready_unqual，并作为仲裁器的 unlock 条件
旧设计每个周期通过 VX_find_first 选 tag，没有在 stall 期间维持 grant 所有权
arbiter helper 的配套修复说明“陈旧缓冲 grant”也是同一类前向进展问题的一部分
notes: 可移植的缺陷本质是背压下响应组归属不稳定
如果希望更小的变异，通常只移除选择器的锁保持就足以重现问题，而不必完全回退 helper arbiter
